subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Phantom Debt Collector
description: A 60-second lesson on The Phantom Debt Collector.

hook.text: A caller says you owe money from a debt you don't remember. They threaten jail if you don't pay now.

buildup.text: Phantom debt collectors demand payment for debts that were already paid, settled, or never existed.

discovery.text: They use personal data from breaches to sound legitimate and intimidate victims.

twist.text: Real debt collectors must send written validation. Phone-only demands are almost always scams.

climax.text: Fear of legal action makes people pay debts they don't owe, costing consumers millions yearly.

punchline.text: You can't go to jail for debt. They're counting on you not knowing that.

quiz.question: What must legitimate debt collectors provide?
